headline: Revolut Valuation Reaches $115 Billion Following New Funding Round
summary: Fintech firm Revolut completed a new funding round that raised its valuation to $115 billion, representing a 53% increase from its previous $75 billion valuation set in November 2025.
why: Valuation milestones for major private financial technology firms signal investor appetite and liquidity trends within the global digital banking and fintech sector.

impacts.name: Revolut
impacts.why: A successful funding round at a higher valuation directly reflects increased enterprise worth.
